fact: UNESCO's hub records a 2025-2029 digital inclusion project led by ADPV with the education ministry, whose pilot trained over 150 young people.
UNESCO's project 3210652071 (USD 166,800, 66% progress, 2024-2025) on digital skills and media and information literacy for populations is on going, with an allocation to this country (Tchad 15%).

UNHCR and the Government of Chad established the Iridimi Digital Learning Center, which with Arizona State University offers online training to refugees and host-community youth, with certified office tools and digital literacy training to follow.

The World Bank approved on 2024-09-25 the Chad Digital Transformation Project, which will strengthen the digital skills of the population and train about 40,000 beneficiaries directly, at least 25,000 of them women and girls.
